product_boundary: exactly one executable file named EntityOS

unusual_experiment_accounting.reason: The macro-cycle had already executed its bounded unusual experiment before canonical fusion; the post-merge main gate deliberately skipped the unusual step to avoid duplicate experiment accounting.
unusual_experiment_accounting.prior_macro_cycle_experiment: single-file launch after sidecar amputation / empty working directory

negative_results_preserved: The first transitional zipapp exact VPS run built one file but failed parser boot because lark was not bundled.
After bundling lark, local archive execution exposed an archive-hostile pathlib grammar read; exact grammar bytes were embedded as a bounded transport repair.
The transitional zipapp still required host Python and therefore was not final self-contained EntityOS.
A concurrent alternative native zero-python freeze experiment failed its clean-directory gate and was not selected as canonical product evidence.

primary_external_evidence.python_zipapp: Python documentation confirms zipapp execution requires an appropriate interpreter.
primary_external_evidence.pyinstaller: PyInstaller 6.21.0 documentation states one-file bundles can run without a separately installed Python interpreter.

remaining_release_blockers: Fresh compatible clean-Ubuntu zero-install portability is not yet accepted across the required target matrix; env/PATH isolation is supportive but not a fresh-OS proof.
Canonical ClayCode still lacks the complete provenance-bound String/Bytes/argv/env/cwd/stdin/stdout/stderr/PTY and effectful TypedIR/VM surface required for full CM-TERM and CM-DATA closure.
CM-NET, CM-VIS and CM-AUDIO remain open.
Persistent ClayOS state/services, crash/restart/recovery and broader machine lifecycle acceptance remain open.
The final small-computer EntityOS user surface and full minimal-ClayOS boot scope are not yet release-accepted.
next_executable_action: Keep this exact frozen one-file boundary as the canonical packaging gate; next select and implement the smallest provenance-bound Clay String/Bytes/argv ownership+effect ABI shared by CM-TERM and CM-DATA, wire it through checker -> executable TypedIR -> single ClayVM -> ClayOS, rebuild the exact EntityOS file, and rerun the current-main artifact gate on a fresh compatible Ubuntu target when available.
